about: The two evaluation cases required by Assignment 7 section 5.2. Case 1 is a clean minimal run where everything works. Case 2 triggers a human-in-the-loop (HITL) event that staff then resolve. All people, employers, numbers and documents are FAKE (synthetic). Every SSN is in the 900-series test range.
how_to_check_automatically: python -m pytest tests/test_fixtures_and_evals.py -q   (runs both cases through the real Extraction, Rules, Computation and Review agents; the LangGraph run itself is covered by the CLI steps below)

cases.title: Clean minimal run
cases.assignment_reference: Section 6 D.1 (clean run, filled-in 1040-SR) and D.3 (W-2 amounts read from an image)

dashboard: Open http://localhost:8501 and look for session eval-case-1 under All returns, status Draft ready.

expected.line_37_amount_owed: not present (the return is a refund)

hand_derivation: Line 1a/1z/9/11a = W-2 box 1 = 31,250 (no other income, no adjustments)
Line 12d = 1 box (age 65 or older; born 1 June 1955, before 2 January 1961, so 1040-SR eligible)
Line 13b = 6,000 senior deduction; AGI 31,250 is below the 75,000 phase-out
Line 16 = 10% of 7,500 = 750 (inside the first single bracket)
pass_criteria: Extraction reads W-2 boxes 1 to 6 exactly as printed, none flagged uncertain
No escalation is raised and nobody has to intervene
Review passes on the first attempt
A filled-in 1040-SR (HTML with provenance, and the IRS PDF) is produced from the dashboard
Every dollar line has a provenance record; lines 1a and 25a point to W-2 'w2_1' boxes 1 and 2 with the extractor and time

cases.title: Human-in-the-loop event, resolved by staff
cases.assignment_reference: Section 4.4 condition 6 (financial exploitation: refund routed to an account the taxpayer cannot describe), Section 6 D.4
cases.w2_image_note: A slightly crooked, noisy 'scanned' W-2 to show the reader copes with a poorer picture. It still reads cleanly.

taxpayer.refund_account_owner: unknown (the taxpayer could not say whose account the refund goes to)

cases.trigger: intake.refund.account_owner = unknown. Rules raises escalation E6 (STOP): 'Refund account is not in the taxpayer's name'.

escalation.reason: Refund account is not in the taxpayer's name

before_resolution.draft_lines: none yet: no return is computed while a STOP escalation is open

how_to_resolve.why_it_stops: SilverFile must notice and stop when a refund is routed to an account the taxpayer cannot describe, because elder financial abuse often travels through tax refunds. It does not decide whether anything is wrong; a person does.
in_the_dashboard: 1. Start the session: python run.py start --input demo/eval_case_2_input.json --thread-id eval-case-2
2. Put the staff sign-in in .env (copy .env.example): SILVERFILE_STAFF_IDS=demo_staff and SILVERFILE_STAFF_PASSCODE=silverfile-demo
3. Start the dashboard: python -m streamlit run streamlit_app.py and open http://localhost:8501
4. In the sidebar sign in as demo_staff with passcode silverfile-demo (without signing in the page is read-only).
5. Under HITL queue, find eval-case-2 (code E6, 'Refund account is not in the taxpayer's name') and click Open & resolve.
6. Read the reason and 'what the taxpayer heard'. Choose the option 'Verified, continue' (nothing is preselected).
7. Type a note, for example: Phoned the taxpayer; the refund account is in his own name. Verified.
8. Click Resolve and resume. The session moves to Draft ready.
9. Open the return: the Escalations tab shows E6 resolved with your staff ID, time, decision and note; the Draft form tab shows the filled 1040-SR with line 34 = 1,995.
on_the_command_line: python run.py start --input demo/eval_case_2_input.json --thread-id eval-case-2      (prints pending_escalation: esc_0001)
python run.py resume --thread-id eval-case-2 --input demo/eval_case_2_resolution.json  (the resolution payload is already prepared)
python run.py status --thread-id eval-case-2      (prints status draft_ready)
how_to_resolve.other_choices: close_session ends the case without a return; flag_for_review also stops the draft and leaves it for a volunteer. Only verified_continue produces the finished return.

pass_criteria: Extraction reads the scanned W-2 exactly, none flagged uncertain
The run pauses with status awaiting_human and exactly one open escalation, E6 esc_0001, and no tax lines are computed yet
Resolving with verified_continue, a note and a staff ID resumes the same session (nothing is re-asked)
The escalation record keeps the decision, staff ID, note and time (audit trail)
Review passes and a filled-in 1040-SR is produced with line 34 = 1,995
